proof_body:
by
  intro P
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range, Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range]
  constructor
  · rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases h : Even i
    · simp [h, h.neg_one_pow]
    · have h' : Odd i := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp h
      simp [h, h'.neg_one_pow]
  · rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases h : Odd i
    · simp [h, h.neg_one_pow]
    · have h' : Even i := Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp h
      simp [h, h'.neg_one_pow]
target_source: ∀ P : Polynomial ℝ, (P.eval 1 + P.eval (-1)) / 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), (if Even i then P.coeff i else 0) ∧ (P.eval 1 - P.eval (-1)) / 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), (if Odd i then P.coeff i else 0)
